name: 7,8-Dihydroxyflavone
summary: F Tropoflavin, also known as 7,8-dihydroxyflavone (7,8-DHF), is a naturally occurring flavone found in Godmania aesculifolia, Tridax procumbens, and Primula vulgaris. It has been found to act as a potent and selective small-molecule agonist of the tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB) (Kd ≈ 320 nM), the main signaling receptor of the neurotrophin brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF).

pharmacology.text: It has been found to act as a potent and selective small-molecule agonist of the tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB) (Kd ≈ 320 nM), the main signaling receptor of the neurotrophin brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF). A prodrug of tropoflavin with greatly improved potency and pharmacokinetics, R13 (and, formerly, R7), is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

uses.text: A prodrug of tropoflavin with greatly improved potency and pharmacokinetics, R13 (and, formerly, R7), is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

summaryZh: 7,8-二羥基黃酮是一種天然黃酮，存在於長柄菊（學名：Tridax procumbens）等植物中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It has been studied mostly in animals, and its effects and risks in people have not been established.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它主要在動物身上被研究，在人體的作用與風險尚未確立。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它主要在动物身上被研究，在人体的作用与风险尚未确立。

fact.en: It is a flavone, from the same large family of plant pigments as the colours in berries and tea, and it is found in plants including the common primrose.
fact.zh: 它是一種黃酮，與莓果和茶中的色素屬於同一大類植物色素家族，並存在於包括西洋櫻草在內的植物中。
